Global Semiconductor Outlook
Q3 Global Semiconductor Sales Rose 16% QoQ; 
September Sales Up 7% MoM.
•Growth  was supported by continued robust AI and HPC -related 
demand for CPUs, GPUs, data center communications chips, 
memory and power chips
•Analog -mixed -signal peers posted mixed Q3 performance, 
with YoY revenue growth ranging from -2% to +25%
•Long -term outlook remains strong, supported by government 
policies promoting R&D and infrastructure investment
•Uncertainty remains on US tax tariff exemptions and trade 
policies 
•Key Industry Challenges
➢Geopolitical tensions 
➢Growing global talent shortage
➢Capacity imbalances: oversupply /shortage in certain 
manufacturing and raw materials segments
